rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone who behaves with good manners.

example.english: They are very polite to everyone.
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this for someone whose manner is refined, gentle, or well-behaved, rather than simply stating that they have good manners.

example.english: They speak in a very polite, refined way.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 si1 man4
